t: Look at the building in front of you. This is No 1 Poultry, a commercial building of offices and shops in the City of London. It fills the pointed corner where Poultry and Queen Victoria Street meet at Mansion House Street, on the western approach to the Bank junction. It was designed by Sir James Stirling, the British architect, and it stands as one of his works in the heart of the City, among much older and more traditional neighbours.
